**Beast 1.**

Which of the following situations will NOT result in a race condition?

* A. Multiple processes writing to shared data simultaneously

* B. One process reading and another process writing to shared data

* C. Multiple processes reading shared data simultaneously

* D. Multiple processes executing unrelated code simultaneously

---

**妖獸 2.**

關於功能性程式設計語言，以下哪些陳述是正確的？

* A. 變數是不可變的

* B. Erlang 和 Scala 是此類語言的例子

* C. 它們不維護狀態

* D. 它們可以避免資料競爭

---

**Beast 3.**

In the solution to the Readers-Writers Problem, what is the purpose of the read_count variable?

* A. To track the number of waiting processes

* B. To track the number of writers

* C. To track the number of readers

* D. To track the number of completed tasks

---

**妖獸 4.**

臨界區問題的「進度」要求指的是什麼？

* A. 程序在臨界區內的等待時間有限

* B. 請求進入臨界區的程序不能被無限期推遲

* C. 只有一個程序可以進入臨界區

* D. 每個程序都必須按照特定順序進入

---

**Beast 5.**

Which type of programming language's variables are immutable, helping to avoid data races?

* A. C++

* B. Python

* C. Java

* D. Functional Programming Languages

---

* A. Semaphores

* B. Mutex Locks

* C. Spinlocks

* D. Monitors

**Beast 9.**

* A. A hybrid synchronization tool

* B. Pure busy waiting

* C. A user-space synchronization tool

* D. A kernel-level synchronization tool
